strategies.text: Slam stun and moderate melee. Pull alone if possible; two Watchmen can join, so crowd-control one.
Only Pierce Armor on the tank. Kill the boss before the miners around him.
Clear the room first (Sneed fears). Kill the Shredder first; Sneed then emerges and disarms whoever holds threat.
Molten Metal slows by half; Blessing of Freedom removes it. Kill Gilnid, then the goblin workers.
Stuns twice while swapping weapons and uses Thrash. Kill the two Blackguard adds first; a stun with them alive can kill a player.
Nature DoT on the tank and a self heal. Avoid pulling with extra trash.
Cleave plus Poisoned Harpoon on the tank. Kill the companion, then the boss, then the two remaining adds.
No real abilities beyond Thrash. Kill the first two Blackguards quickly. At 50% he summons two more unless he is stunned as he crosses the threshold.

notes: Boss NPC IDs match the list in Wowhead's Deadmines guide (644, 3586, 642, 1763, 646, 647, 639, 645) and each page was opened. All seven boss positions are OpenMap (Encounter Journal) data; Miner Johnson (rare) has no position. Floor 1 -> floor 2 transition is not marked on the map art; the route step is an estimate. Forever added loot (Ogre Loincloth, Bandsaw Wristbands, Goblin Hammer, Lookie's Spyglass, First Mate Band, Dull Sawblade) but no layout change was reported. Quest givers (Gryan Stoutmantle, Scout Riell, Wilder Thistlenettle, Shoni) are outside.
